Removes a mark by name, or every mark at once with --all — the marks 'kx state drop --all' deliberately leaves behind.

## Usage

```text
kx unmark [OPTIONS] [name]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[name]` | Mark name to remove |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | Remove every mark |

## Global options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-color` | Disable styled output |
| `-h, --help` | Show this message and exit |

## Examples

```bash
kx unmark api
kx unmark --all
```
